d: In this video, Firstpost explains the controversies surrounding the 75th Miss Universe pageant ahead of its grand finale in Puerto Rico. From Miss Israel being booed over her national costume and Miss Vietnam being dethroned to six Southeast Asian nations being barred, the competition has faced multiple setbacks. Visa complications have also forced several contestants to withdraw, while Miss France's organisation has protested the pageant's direction.
